newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is seen adding reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Wednesday, analysts said,
An operation is deemed necessary, they said, since the Fed is projected to still have a small add need and Wednesday is the final day of the maintenance period.
The Fed executed overnight system RPs both Monday and Tuesday.
Federal funds were under pressure Wednesday, trading at 5-5/8 percent -- well above the 5-1/4 percent target rate.

The tight funds rate makes it more probable the Fed will enter the open market earlier than its usual 1130 EST/1630 GMT intervention period. In recent weeks, the Fed has entered the market early numerous times at about 1030 EST/1530 EST.
The New York Fed will discuss its recent pattern of open market operations in a press briefing later this afternoon.
